newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian forex reserves $16.414 bln in September.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian forex reserves $16.414 bln in September.

text.p: Indonesian foreign exchange reserves stood at $16.414 billion in September against $16.428 billion in August, a central bank official told Reuters.
The central bank official said foreign exchange reserves edged down slightly from the peak of $16.482 billion in June when the central bank was forced to support the dollar.
Foreign exchange reserves in July totalled $16.450 billion.
